Description:
This large assorted rock, mineral, and gemstone collection is suitable for beginners and enthusiasts. It includes three boxed collections: Beginner's Rock Collection, Rocks and Minerals to Meet the Demands of Space Age Technology, and Ozark Collection. Each box contains labeled specimens of minerals, rocks, and gemstones such as agate, obsidian, sulphur, copper ore, and others. The lot also contains multiple compartmentalized storage boxes and bags with a wide variety of loose stones, tumbled stones, rough mineral samples, and labeled specimens including purple smithsonite, quartz, aventurine, chryscolla, blue topaz, garnet, peridot, and emerald. Additional items include tumbled stones set in wire cages for necklaces, a velvet pouch, and a tin with more rocks. Most items show signs of use or vintage wear, with some wear on boxes.

10 x 12 x 10 in

The pieces range in translucency from translucent to transparent and exhibit a pearly luster. Most specimens are colorless or white, with one showing a light tan hue. The crystals display characteristic striated and bladed formations and are in raw, unpolished condition with some natural edge chipping. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.
